name: ft_ping
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential wget && mkdir -p /tmp/inetutils-build && wget -O /tmp/inetutils-build/inetutils-2.0.tar.gz https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/inetutils/inetutils-2.0.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/inetutils-build/inetutils-2.0.tar.gz -C /tmp/inetutils-build && cd /tmp/inetutils-build/inetutils-2.0 && ./configure --prefix=/usr/local/inetutils-2.0 && make && sudo make install && echo 'export PATH="/usr/local/inetutils-2.0/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc
